scope: Independent recursive capacity-cover and explicit AutF orbits; every host join and saved graph checked with bitwise common-neighbor test. No S completion rerun; terminal completeness rests on audited exhaustive star traversal, with unresolved frontier preserved.
algorithm_audit: Each node chooses one unfinished singleton vertex and enumerates all subsets of unfinished neighbors that fill its required degree. An edge to an already fixed vertex cannot be in a completion because that vertex has full degree. A new C4 in a star addition uses the center once, hence either one new spoke and an existing length-three path, or two new spokes and a shared old neighbor of their endpoints. The two source tests exactly cover these cases. Degree feasibility pruning is necessary. State restoration is exact after every successful recursive return; timeout aborts that base and never yields COMPLETE. Aggregate deadline stops further bases. Therefore COMPLETE records are exhaustive under the audited code; no independent S enumeration replay is claimed.
